title: Factorization through the stabilized coherent formal kernel
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_factorization {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ a : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), a.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) (K : CoherentFormalModule X I) (ι : K ⟶ F) (e : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≅ K.obj.obj (op n)) (htrans : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 2) (S.obj (op (n + 1 + c))) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = S.map (homOfLE (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) c)).op ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom) (hcomp : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + c))) ≫ (e n).hom ≫ ι.hom.app (op n) = j.app (op (n + c)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n c)).op) (T : CoherentFormalModule X I) (γ : T ⟶ F) (hγ : γ ≫ α = 0) : ∃ δ : T ⟶ K, δ ≫ ι = γ

proof.text: Factor each annihilated component through the later levelwise kernel image. Inductively descend compatible maps through successive ideal-power quotient projections. Use idealModuleProduct_quotient_comp_zero_iff already proved privately in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentFormalModule, accessed by a proof-only import all, to transfer annihilation across epimorphic transitions. Epimorphic transitions establish compatibility and the equation with the inclusion. No duplicate ideal-product or multiplication-naturality lemmas are stated.
